subject: Marketplace license & metering audit request — Q3/Q4 billing reconciliation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodai.com>
To: ops@cloudsphere.com, sara.bennett@amazon.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodai.com, laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace license & metering audit request — Q3/Q4 billing reconciliation

Hi team,

We need a SKU-level metering and license reconciliation for our Q3–Q4 invoices across listings on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Finance flagged a set of unexpected overage line items and a handful of listing fee credits that were applied inconsistently between accounts.

Can you send: 
- A machine-readable export of metering events (SKU, timestamp, quantity, customer account id) for 2026-07-01 through 2026-11-30;
- A mapping of SKU IDs to Marketplace listing SKUs and product names;
- All invoice line items where listing fees or listing credits were applied (with invoice ids);
- Any marketplace-side rule changes or pricing promos that hit during this period.

Attached: a sample Redwood invoice and a brief metering request form. Prefer CSV export, and if possible include a checksum/hash for file verification.

Next steps: please confirm availability for a 30–45 minute audit call this week (US PST preferable). If any data cannot be shared due to partner policy, flag it and we can provide a formal NDA or execute a narrow data access request.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwoodai.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: metering_audit_request_form.docx, redwood_sample_invoice_Q4.pdf
From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodai.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace license & metering audit request — Q3/Q4 billing reconciliation

Hi Camila — thanks for the clear list. I pulled an export for AWS Marketplace SKUs and attached an initial CSV (aws_metering_export_Q3Q4.csv). The file contains event-level rows (sku, customer_account, timestamp, quantity, partner_fee_code). 

A few quick notes:
- We applied two promotional credits in Aug and a temporary listing fee waiver for a pilot in September for the SKU redwood-rt-1. Those were applied at partner-configuration time and will show as negative line items on the invoice.
- For full invoice rows and invoice PDFs, we need a PO or a signed data sharing addendum; happy to route that to our legal ops.

I can be on a call Wed 11/2 at 10:00 PST or Thu 11/3 at 08:00 PST. If that works, I'll invite our billing specialist and the marketplace operations lead.

Attached: aws_metering_export_Q3Q4.csv

—Sara
Sara Bennett
AWS Marketplace Partner Lead
sara.bennett@amazon.com
+1 (206) 555-0199
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace license & metering audit request — Q3/Q4 billing reconciliation

Camila / Laura — forwarding Sara's response and the CSV she shared. Quick take: the Aug promo + Sep pilot waiver explain some of the negative line items, but the volume aggregation looks off for a set of enterprise customers (acct ids starting with 78*).

Recommendation: ask AWS for invoice PDFs for the top 10 invoice ids in the export (we can redact customer PII) and request a one-time credit reconciliation if we identify double-billing on listing fees. Laura — do we have headroom for a small remediation credit (up to $30k) without pulling exec approval? If not, we should route to finance and CC leadership.

Also flagging that GCP and Azure will likely have different export formats — I'll reach out to their reps after we confirm the AWS-level invoices.

-Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodai.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace license & metering audit request — Q3/Q4 billing reconciliation

Thanks for the summary. Approve moving forward with the audit and collecting the top-10 invoice PDFs from AWS. We have delegated authority to approve remediation credits up to $25k; anything beyond that needs VP-signed approval. Please:

- Camila: open the PO / data sharing addendum request with Sara and ask for the invoice PDFs and any promotional configuration logs;
- Aditya: reach out to our GCP and Azure contacts and request equivalent event-level exports and invoice lists (ask them to match the field set Sara provided where possible);
- CC finance (finance-ops@redwoodai.com) once we have the invoice PDFs so they can start reconciling.

Let's target a follow-up call next Friday to review the reconciled top-line delta and determine whether a credit request is necessary.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
